\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 147-150 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R155-first-pass-words-from-chapters-147-150}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for generous and lazy.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to replace, to blush, to bleed, to make a mistake, to put up with
  \item health, the brain, a lung, the liver, a kidney
  \item a dream, anxiety, love, friendship, hope
  \item rarely, then, finally, from now on, still
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To replace? (\textbf{substituir}.) To blush? (\textbf{corar}.) To bleed? (\textbf{sangrar}.) To make a mistake? (\textbf{enganar-se}.) To put up with? (\textbf{aguentar}.) Health? (\textbf{a saúde}.) The brain? (\textbf{o cérebro}.) A lung? (\textbf{o pulmão}.) The liver? (\textbf{o fígado}.) A kidney? (\textbf{o rim}.) A dream? (\textbf{o sonho}.) Anxiety? (\textbf{a ansiedade}.) Love? (\textbf{o amor}.) Friendship? (\textbf{a amizade}.) Hope? (\textbf{a esperança}.) Rarely? (\textbf{raramente}.) Then? (\textbf{a seguir}.) Finally? (\textbf{finalmente}.) From now on? (\textbf{a partir de agora}.) Still? (\textbf{ainda}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 151-155 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R155-second-pass-words-from-chapters-151-155}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for above and below.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item above, below, at the bottom, elsewhere, up there
  \item therefore, anyway, although, despite, unfortunately
  \item comfortable, uncomfortable, polite, rude, unpleasant
  \item complicated, necessary, useful, useless, strange
  \item punctual, honest, patient, generous, lazy
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Above? (\textbf{em cima}.) Below? (\textbf{em baixo}.) At the bottom? (\textbf{ao fundo}.) Elsewhere? (\textbf{noutro lado}.) Up there? (\textbf{lá em cima}.) Therefore? (\textbf{portanto}.) Anyway? (\textbf{de qualquer maneira}.) Although? (\textbf{embora}.) Despite? (\textbf{apesar de}.) Unfortunately? (\textbf{infelizmente}.) Comfortable? (\textbf{confortável}.) Uncomfortable? (\textbf{desconfortável}.) Polite? (\textbf{educado / educada}.) Rude? (\textbf{mal-educado / mal-educada}.) Unpleasant? (\textbf{desagradável}.) Complicated? (\textbf{complicado / complicada}.) Necessary? (\textbf{necessário / necessária}.) Useful? (\textbf{útil}.) Useless? (\textbf{inútil}.) Strange? (\textbf{estranho / estranha}.) Punctual? (\textbf{pontual}.) Honest? (\textbf{honesto / honesta}.) Patient? (\textbf{paciente}.) Generous? (\textbf{generoso / generosa}.) Lazy? (\textbf{preguiçoso / preguiçosa}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
